transcript:
Today was a busy day, but it felt like I got a lot done. I started the morning with a quick workout, focusing on bodyweight exercises. I’ve been trying to build strength in my core, so I did some planks, leg raises, and push-ups. It’s not much, but it’s a start. I’m hoping to gradually build a routine that will help me get closer to my goal of having a more athletic body, similar to a tennis player’s physique.

After that, I had a cup of coffee and began working on my audio journaling app. It’s going to be such a useful tool for both my personal reflections and my future content creation. I spent the entire morning trying to fix a bug with the WebRTC connection. The issue was related to microphone access, and I couldn’t figure it out for a while. Finally, after some debugging and checking browser permissions, I managed to get it working. Now I can record audio directly into the app!

In the afternoon, I went over some concepts from my quantum mechanics reading. I’m still trying to digest the ideas from Leonard Susskind’s book Quantum Mechanics: The Theoretical Minimum. It's challenging but fascinating. I also reviewed my thesis outline and made some small revisions. I’ve got about a month to finalize everything, so I need to stay focused and on track.

Later in the evening, I spent some time working on the Flipper Zero add-on project. I’m really excited about the idea of adding a WiFi chip and enabling Spotify functionality on the device. It’s a bit of a long shot, but the thought of it being fully functional is motivating. I watched a few YouTube videos on PCB design and 3D modeling to brush up on the skills I need for the project.

I ended the day with a long walk to clear my mind. It felt good to step away from the screens and just focus on the physical activity. I’ve been spending too much time working indoors lately, and I can feel it in my posture. A little fresh air always helps to reset.

Now, I’m getting ready for bed. Tomorrow is going to be another busy day with more coding and learning, but I’m excited to keep making progress on all my projects. There’s always something new to work on, and that keeps me motivated. I’ll sleep well tonight knowing I’ve made some positive strides toward my goals.
summary: Today was a busy day, but it felt like I got a lot done. I spent the entire morning trying to fix a bug with the WebRTC connection. I also reviewed my thesis outline and made some small revisions. Tomorrow is going to be another busy day with more coding and learning.
